description: This file defines a utility enum OverlayPanelFactory that provides a suite of static methods to create, animate, present, and dismiss overlay panels/windows in a macOS application using AppKit. It encapsulates behavior related to panel appearance, animation, and event management.

methods.name: makePanel
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSPanel with specified content rectangle, window level, shadow, and mouse event acceptance.

methods.name: animatePresent
methods.description: Animates the presentation of a window from a start frame to a target frame with fade-in effect.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Animates the window to a specified frame with easing.

methods.name: applyFrame
methods.description: Sets the frame of a window either instantly or with animation.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Handles presentation of a window, executing callbacks for first-time or re-presentations, with optional entrance animation.

methods.name: animateDismiss
methods.description: Animates the dismissal of a window by moving it and fading out, then calls a completion handler.

methods.name: animateDismissAndHide
methods.description: Performs animated dismissals of window and then hides it, with callback upon hiding.

methods.name: clearGlobalEventMonitor
methods.description: Removes and clears a global event monitor handle.
